findings.summary: The edited line is not rewrapped, so it runs to about 125 characters while the surrounding paragraph wraps near 90. This has no effect on correctness (Prettier ignores *.md); rewrapping 'Every entry has a trunk...' onto the next line would keep the paragraph consistent.
